## Where it came from

What happened, or what was asked, that made a decision necessary. Name the
event, the conversation or the document — something a reader can go and find.

## Decision

What was decided. Then what was deliberately left out, so that nobody later
reads the gap as an oversight.

## Why

The reasons, each leaning on a source where one exists: [S1].

## Expires when

The observable condition that would make this decision wrong. "Never" is an
answer, but it has to be written down.
